name: docker-compose
description: Escape hatch: deploy any Docker Compose stack you supply by URL. Your compose must bind something to 127.0.0.1:${SITE_PORT}.

compose_yaml_url.description: URL to a raw docker-compose.yml (e.g. a private gist's raw URL). The role fetches this at every deploy. Your compose must reference ${SITE_PORT} for the host port binding.
